notes.subject: דשה
notes.rationale: 'At grass/tender grass' (KJV, JPS) vs 'treading out grain' (ASV) — from דשא sprout, favoring grass.

notes.subject: כאברים
notes.rationale: אבירים: 'strong ones' — bulls (KJV) vs stallions/neighing horses (ASV, JPS, since צהל suits horse-neigh).

notes.subject: Babel/Kasdim
notes.rationale: Direct feminine-singular address to Babylon as plunderer of Israel's inheritance.

notes.subject: כי ×3
notes.rationale: Triple כי anaphora driving the indictment, flattened in Tok Pisin 'bikos'.

translation: Bikos yu amamas, bikos yu singaut gutpela, yu ol i planda ⟨את⟩ wok sareri bilong mi; bikos yu wokabaut wankain olsem pikinini bulmakau meri long gras, na yu singaut strong olsem ol strongpela bulmakau man —
